title: The Commons
hero_prompt: A fine antique engraving of a shared commons: a tended green field worked by many different hands, distinct small workshops linked by woven threads of light, no single owner at the center. Delicate cross-hatching, old cartographer's linework, warm ink on aged paper, panoramic composition with a darker upper register.
icon_prompt: A bold high-contrast square emblem in pure black and white: many distinct threads woven into one shared knot, or open hands meeting around a common field. Sharp geometric printmaking silhouette, no gradients.
